The oldest campus in the California State University system is **San José State University** (founded in 1857), and its official motto is:

**“Vox Veritas Vita”**  
— *Voice, Truth, Life.*

This Latin phrase is the motto of the CSU system as a whole and has been used by SJSU since it was adopted (revised from the earlier “Vir Veritas Vox” in 1985).
